brief:
Israeli forces killed at least five people in Gaza, including a seven-year-old girl, Al Jazeera English reported. The deaths occurred amid continued military operations in the territory where Israel's war has killed at least 74,555 people overall.

The reported fatalities bring the death toll since a ceasefire last year to 1,559, according to the outlet's count of casualties in the ongoing conflict.
dek: The death toll in Israel's genocidal war on Gaza climbs to 74,555, including 1,559 killed since 'ceasefire' last year.
title: Israeli forces kill five in Gaza including seven-year-old girl
